Priya: noticed p99 spike on /api/generate after yesterday's debug-tracing rollout. p99 went from ~120ms -> 230ms, collector CPU up from 40% -> 85%.
Kyle: is this the otel collector fleet? any correlation with span volume?
Priya: yep otel-collector in us-east, span/sec jumped 3x (~~6000 -> 18k). small spans (<200B) dominating. infra-bot: alert: collector-cpu-high (us-east) fired at 2026-02-18T14:18:22Z :rotating_light:
Sam: any recent changes to sampling? debug-tracing flags?
Priya: we rolled out service-level debug for a single customer — it propagated to many downstream components and started emitting dense client spans.
Julian: suspect exporter backpressure + batching config. queue filling causes extra syscall overhead and thread contention, pushing p99 up.
Kyle: can you paste collector config? especially `batch` exporter settings and `queued_retry` queuesize.
Priya: pasted snippet:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/http:
    endpoint: ingest.redwood:4318
    retry_on_failure: true
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 200ms
    send_batch_size: 1024
  queued_retry:
    queue_size: 5000
```
Sam: send_batch_size 1024 is too big for lots of tiny spans — CPU cost per batch is misleading. try smaller batch (256) + increase timeout (500ms) to let collector coalesce.
Julian: also consider lowering `queued_retry.queue_size` to avoid huge memory churn and GC pauses; add attribute filtering to drop debug-only tags early: `processors.attributes` to remove debug-only tags.
Kyle: alternative: sample earlier at app SDK (1%) or use tail-based sampling at collector with rule for debug=true keep 0%.
Priya: action plan: 1) rollback debug sampling for that customer 2) tune batch.send_batch_size -> 256, timeout 500ms 3) add attributes processor to drop verbose tags 4) monitor p99 + collector CPU for 1hr. rolling now.
infra-bot: deploy started: otel-collector-config update by priya at 2026-02-18T14:25:10Z
Priya: quick numbers after change (15m in): span/sec down to 6.8k, collector CPU ~48%, p99 back to ~130ms. will keep watching :thumbsup:
Kyle: great. follow-up: we should add a guard in console rollouts UX to warn when enabling debug tracing globally — small change in product backlog.
Sam: filing ticket: PLAT-2114 add rollout UX warning + automatic sampling cap. assigning to @product.
Priya: thanks team, closing thread once metrics stable.
